description: Per-character ground/air movement tuning: run speed and turning, inertial/lean animation, target and camera-relative slowdowns, guard/landing inertia and landing rigidity.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name (exported as ID). ResolveDataRows looks it up with ActionDataTable.Id_ActionMove and stores the row as AGameCharacter.ActionMoveRow; CP_210 also resolves a special sheathed row CP_210_2.

Foreground_Angle.simple: Angular cone for movement against the camera view that triggers slowdown.
Foreground_Angle.technical: Degrees. When bForegroundSlow is set and this value > 0, the angle between view-forward and move direction is tested: slowdown applies when 180 - Angle/2 <= angle (within half the cone of straight-back). 0 disables the effect. CP_010 exports 180.

Foreground_Speed_Rate.simple: Minimum speed multiplier at the center of the foreground slowdown cone.
Foreground_Speed_Rate.technical: Used with Foreground_Angle: Factor = (180-angle)/(Angle/2) * (1 - Rate) + Rate, clamped to [0,1] and multiplied into speed. CP_010 exports 1.0, so no slowdown inside the cone.

Target_Speed_Distance.simple: Distance within which movement near the target is slowed.
Target_Speed_Distance.technical: World units (2D distance from character Location3F0 to target). When bTargetSlow is set, distance <= this value activates Target_Speed_Rate interpolation. CP_010 exports 1500.

Target_Speed_Rate.simple: Speed multiplier at zero distance from the target.
Target_Speed_Rate.technical: Factor = distance/Target_Speed_Distance * (1 - Rate) + Rate, clamped to [0,1]; at the target the multiplier equals this value, at the distance boundary it is 1. CP_010 exports 0.8.

ParallelAttack_Speed_Rate.simple: Speed multiplier while a parallel attack action is active.
ParallelAttack_Speed_Rate.technical: When IsAttackActionFlag15A() is true, GetMoveSpeed multiplies by this value before the overall move-speed rate. CP_010 exports 1.0.

Run_Rotation_Time.simple: Time window over which the run turn is completed.
Run_Rotation_Time.technical: Seconds. FGameCharacterAction::Start initializes RotationTimer from it; movement controller computes the remaining turn duration as this value minus MovePhaseElapsed. CP_010 exports 0.175.

Run_Speed_Start.simple: Initial run speed when starting a run move phase.
Run_Speed_Start.technical: Units/second. SETMOVE_START_RUN starts FloatInterp28 from this value (unscaled) toward GetRunSpeedRate() * Run_Speed_End. CP_010 exports 750.

Run_Speed_End.simple: Target run speed at the end of the interpolation.
Run_Speed_End.technical: Units/second, multiplied by GetRunSpeedRate() before being passed as interpolation end. CP_010 exports 800.

Run_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds passed to FloatInterp28.Start(From, To, Time, Easing, BlendExp, 2). CP_010 exports 0.5.

Run_EasingType.simple: Easing function for run speed interpolation.
Run_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc before FloatInterp28.Start. CP_010 exports None.

Run_Blend_Exp.simple: Exponent/shape parameter for run speed interpolation.
Run_Blend_Exp.technical: Float passed to FloatInterp28.Start alongside Run_EasingType. CP_010 exports 2.0.

Run_Rotation_Rate.simple: Per-step rotation blend rate when turning toward input.
Run_Rotation_Rate.technical: 0 snaps rotation directly; otherwise the controller calls GameVirtualCamera_LerpRotator with Rate * 60.000004 * Step. Used in both normal and alternate turn paths. CP_010 exports 0.2.

Run_Inertia_Rate.simple: Target inertia magnitude when a run action starts.
Run_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed to MovementController.SetInertia/BlendInertia on run start (EaseOut); CP_010 exports 0.5.

Run_Inertia_Time.simple: Duration over which run inertia is applied.
Run_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed with Run_Inertia_Rate to SetInertia/BlendInertia. CP_010 exports 0.5.

Run_Lean_Rate.simple: Rate used to blend character lean while running.
Run_Lean_Rate.technical: Passed to UpdateLeanRate with Run_Lean_Max; CP_240 also uses it as an explicit per-frame blend (Rate * 60.000004) and gates updates when it is 0. CP_010 exports 0.3.

Run_Lean_Max.simple: Clamp for character lean while running.
Run_Lean_Max.technical: Passed to UpdateLeanRate; CP_240 clamps LeanLR/LeanUD against this row value. CP_010 exports 0.5.

Guard_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed with Guard_Inertia_RateZ to ScaleInertia when ground guard starts; CP_010 exports 0.5.

Guard_Inertia_RateZ.technical: Second argument of ScaleInertia for ground guard; CP_010 exports 0.5.

GuardAir_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed with GuardAir_Inertia_RateZ to ScaleInertia in air guard and CP_180 guard behavior; CP_010 exports 0.3.

GuardAir_Inertia_RateZ.technical: Second argument of ScaleInertia for air guard; CP_010 exports 0.5.

GuardAir_Speed_Start.simple: Initial speed of the air-guard speed interpolation.
GuardAir_Speed_Start.technical: Units/second passed as FloatInterp28 start in the guard-air movement setup; CP_010 exports 10.0.

GuardAir_Speed_End.simple: Final speed of the air-guard speed interpolation.
GuardAir_Speed_End.technical: Units/second passed as FloatInterp28 end; CP_010 exports 2000.0.

GuardAir_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the air-guard speed interpolation.
GuardAir_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds passed to FloatInterp28.Start; CP_010 exports 0.5.

GuardAir_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc; CP_010 exports None.

GuardAir_Blend_Exp.technical: Float passed as the blend exponent in FloatInterp28.Start; CP_010 exports 0.5.

Landing_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed with Landing_Inertia_RateZ to ScaleInertia in the landing action; CP_010 exports 0.3.

Landing_Inertia_RateZ.simple: Vertical inertia multiplier applied on landing.
Landing_Inertia_RateZ.technical: Second ScaleInertia argument in the landing action; CP_010 exports 0.5.

Rigidity_Landing.simple: Rigidity class used to scale landing hit/stun duration.
Rigidity_Landing.technical: EGameActionRigidityType (None/Light/Normal/Heavy). GetLandingRigidityRate converts it to an index into GlobalCorrect.Rigidity_Landing rates, defaulting to 1.0f for an invalid index or missing rate. CP_010 exports Normal.

notes: One exported table with 50 rows; no shards or locale variants for this group.
The row is fetched through AGameCharacter.GetCurrentActionMoveRow(), which prefers the action controller row when present and otherwise the stored ActionMoveRow; CP_210 has a special sheathed row.
Foreground/Target slowdowns are conditional flags at the call site, so the row fields alone do not enable them.
Run_Speed_End and GuardAir speeds are multiplied by owner rates in some paths; values in the export are table-side baselines.
Evidence is reconstructed C++; exported CP_010 values illustrate units but do not characterize every row. Available Content is partial.

usages.detail: Resolves the required ActionMove row from ActionDataTable.Id_ActionMove.
Applies target-distance, camera-relative and parallel-attack speed scaling from this row.
Starts run speed interpolation from Run_Speed_* and easing fields.
Uses Run_Rotation_Rate and lean fields while turning toward input.
Maps Rigidity_Landing to GlobalCorrect rate array.
